Overview.Name: Koppolu Akshitha
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Minimal non-veg, mostly vegetarian; non-veg preferred at Lunch

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked almonds (6 nos)
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + lemon water (no sugar)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + fresh fruit (100 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Poha (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Vegetable upma (80 g) + buttermilk (150 ml)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + grilled fish (200 g) + dal (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: Plain rice (150 g) + chicken curry (200 g) + dal (100 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Plain rice (150 g) + paneer curry (150 g) + dal (100 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Roasted chana (30 g) + green tea (200 ml)
Option 2: Fruit (100 g) + handful of nuts (20 g)
Option 3: Puffed rice (30 g) with cucumber (50 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Dal (180 g) + vegetable curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 2: Paneer curry (150 g) + rice (100 g) + vegetable fry (100 g)
Option 3: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + 2 chapatis

Notes_and_Tips: Keep non-veg mostly to lunch; choose grilled or lightly cooked forms.
Manage portions of rice to control calories; increase vegetable portions.
For hormonal balance: include regular meals and fiber-rich foods.
Avoid deep-fried snacks; choose roasted or steamed options.
Stay hydrated and prefer a short walk after meals when possible.
If craving sweets, have fruit or curd instead of processed sweets.
